texts.Why do you want to join Dust?: Enterprise AI agents are the world I already live in daily: I run a production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines) with shared memory, CRM and 100+ automation routines, operated in public (claw-consensus, verbatim-citation-gate). My track record is the BD side: co-founder of Platinum VC & Incubator ($35M under management, syndicate of 250 VCs/angels), 10,000+ founder calls and 2,000+ institutional-investor calls, with deal-flow pipelines I built and automated myself - first as a self-built CRM, today AI-native. A BDR role at Dust lets me sell a category I build in myself and bring an operator network across the US, Japan, Korea and Europe. Available immediately; US work authorization (O-1 active, no sponsorship needed).

What knowledge or experience do you have: I have built or shipped products or features that incorporate AI/LLMs
I have experience deploying AI tools in an enterprise or team setting
